simulation_assumptions: CSV values are one experimental case; Bontang-to-ECI route inputs are not validated transaction data.
Buyer has not been approached; no offer, acceptance, or sale contract is assumed.
PILOG-owned/operated vessel is the only cost mode in this revision.
Three commission rates are applied cumulatively to gross freight revenue as a simulation assumption.
Other voyage costs aggregate excludes bunker and running cost; port and agency breakdown remains unconfirmed.
DWT-only screening is preliminary; actual cargo capacity, vessel availability, draft, terminal and laycan remain for human review.
Positive freight contribution is a review signal, not an approved minimum margin or evidence of PI Group commodity profit.
